Source screening run: `MTC package test run`

This bundle is runnable by the stock ActivitySim `prototype_mtc` example, layered

## Contents

- `manifest.json`: bundle provenance, file registry, and caveats
- `land_use.csv`: zone table in the MTC vocabulary (TOTHH/TOTEMP/area_type…)
- `households.csv`: fitted households with MTC codes (HHT, year-2000 income)
- `persons.csv`: fitted persons with MTC person types (ptype/pemploy/pstudent)
- `skims/mtc_skims.omx`: the full stock skim inventory — real auto times and
  distances, zero transit and tolls
- `skims/travel_time_skims.omx`: the raw screening skim this was expanded from,
  materialized via `copy`
- `configs/`: the settings overlay layered over the stock configuration
- `metadata/source_screening_bundle_manifest.json`: copied source screening manifest

## Caveats

- seed drawn from real PUMS records
- graded against margins
- ActivitySim behavioural coefficients carry separate provenance for each component. A population drawn from local survey records does not make the travel behaviour local.
- Auto ownership uses the nationally estimated component accepted by the recorded fresh holdout study. Every other behavioral component still uses ActivitySim's stock prototype_mtc coefficients estimated for the San Francisco Bay Area. Component acceptance does not establish destination, mode, timing, assignment, or corridor accuracy.
- All five skim periods carry the same free-flow travel time; congestion by time of day is not represented.
- Every transit skim is zero. Unknown fares and unavailable paths disable mode-choice alternatives. Time-of-day skims represent the configured departures, not period averages. See the transit custody and limitations in mtc_inputs.skim_expansion.transit.
- Household incomes were deflated to year-2000 dollars (BLS CPI-U annual averages 172.2/292.655, source dollar year 2022) because the MTC specifications segment income in 2000 dollars.
- School and college enrolment come from ACS table B14001, which counts enrolled residents of each zone, not seats at schools located there.
- Employment sectors FPSEMPN, AGREMPN and MWTEMPN are zero because the screening land-use source does not distinguish them; uncategorised employment is carried in OTHEMPN.
- Zone densities and area types are computed over gross zone acreage; a large, mostly undeveloped zone reads as more rural than its developed core is.
